figurative_meaning_en: Skill, expertise, or proficiency used in praise
example_sentences_in_bangla: তোমার কেরদানি দেখে সবাই অবাক হয়ে গেল।
এই কাজে তার কেরামতি কাজে লাগবে।
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone was amazed by your skill.
His feat will come in handy for this job.
history: Derived from Persian 'kar-dāni' meaning skill in work, and Arabic 'karāmat' for miraculous feats, adapted into Bengali for praising abilities.
note: The idiom blends Persian and Arabic influences common in Bengali linguistic heritage.
